svg.aria-label: I like taking a real dataset all the way to an honest answer: a simple baseline first, validation without leakage, and a clear note on what the model cannot do. The results that hold up become apps and write-ups. Focus: machine learning on tabular data, model explainability, and big data with PySpark. Currently building: foldsafe, an open-source checker for data leakage in ML code. Open to: machine learning and data roles, internships and collaborations.
